purpose: Wielotygodniowe podsumowanie dziennika zawodnika. Każdy wniosek musi wskazywać dane, zakres czasu i poziom pewności.

minimum_data.84_day_trend: >=8 weekly summaries; label as exploratory if fewer than 10
minimum_data.weakness_pattern: At least 3 separate observations on different dates for a recurring candidate weakness; single entries remain one-off observations

trend_dimensions.interpretation: Trend in self-reported/exercise-specific measures; not an objective scouting rating.
Only use recorded observations; do not infer match understanding from missing notes.
Describe exposure and reported effort, not medical readiness.
Show patterns and encourage adult/coach support; do not diagnose.
Track habits and self-reflection, not personality or mental health diagnoses.
Use encouraging language; no shaming or streak punishment.

trend_calculations.week_over_week_change_percent: (current_week - previous_week) / previous_week * 100; suppress if previous_week == 0 or data completeness differs materially
trend_calculations.skill_trend: Compare median of last 3 weekly values to prior 3 weekly values when enough data exists; show raw sample count.
trend_calculations.consistency_rate: completed_planned_sessions / planned_sessions * 100; exclude coach-cancelled or illness-cancelled sessions from denominator if explicitly marked.
trend_calculations.rpe_efficiency: Do not infer fitness from lower RPE alone. Show RPE alongside session type, duration and wellbeing.
trend_calculations.repeated_signal: Count matching journal tags by distinct dates in rolling 28-day window; >=3 dates = candidate pattern, not confirmed weakness.

confidence_levels.high: Adequate coverage, comparable sessions and repeated observations.
confidence_levels.medium: Some missing entries or mixed session types; show limitations.
confidence_levels.low: Few observations, changing measurement method, or incomplete logs; phrase as a question rather than a conclusion.

rules: Never call a trait a permanent weakness based on one entry.
Always separate self-reported perception from objective measured performance.
Compare like with like: similar drill, duration, role and context.
Do not rank children against each other.
Do not infer absence of training from missing records.
Avoid shaming, streak penalties and alarmist labels.
If wellbeing worsens or pain repeats, recommend discussion with parent/guardian and coach rather than increasing workload.
Present no more than two priority insights at once.
